user_prompt: Build 'ClaimFlow' — a vertical AI agent SaaS for insurance claims intake: gathers documents, triage by policy coverage, validates completeness, drafts the claim summary and routes to an adjuster with GL codes and recommended next steps. Audience: P&C insurers and MGA/broker shops still running paper claims. Product: full-stack SaaS with auth (register/login/2FA, JWT), Stripe subscription (per-claim bundles), landing page with the intake -> validate -> route funnel and a claims demo, and an Agent Console: claims queue with triage status, document checklist, coverage match and fraud-flag hints, adjuster assignment, SLA timers, audit trail and usage/billing. i18n (English, Spanish, French), multi-currency (USD, EUR, GBP), privacy/terms with compliance disclaimer, cookie consent, SEO + OG + JSON-LD + sitemap, institutional trust theme. React 19 + Vite + Tailwind, Express + MySQL, LumicorePro structure. Real and production-ready.
